comment: Atmospheric particles (Phase B, B11): presentation data. Each emitter is a particle recipe (vfx_recipes.json) either following the
camera (follow: camera, at its offset) and running only while the ground under the camera is one of 'grounds' (world material IDs,
as the art bindings' terrain map names them; omitted: anywhere), or placed along the ravine rivers (at: ravine_rivers). 'weather'
lists the states it runs in (omitted: all); day_only: only while the sun is up. Nothing here is simulated or saved.
Asset overhaul 2026-10-14: weather states rain (light rain), storm (heavy rain), fog and snow (--visual weather=<state>).

emitters.note: The Charwood: ash still hangs in its air.
The waystation's meadow and the Cairnwold moor in sunlight.
Under the birch flanks: a leaf now and then.
Mist over the river on the ravine floors.
